description: Generate a color harmony from a base color. base accepts a hex, CSS name, RNV brand name, or saved-palette reference (e.g. 'Spring line:2'). scheme is one of: complementary, analogous, triadic, split-complementary, tetradic (a.k.a. square), monochromatic, compound. Returns a list of hex colors. Read-only and deterministic: it derives the colors from the base and stores nothing, so it has no side effects and is safe to call repeatedly. Use to expand one base color into a related set; to blend existing colors into a single color use mix_colors, and to persist a set you like use save_palette.
name: generate_harmony
